senses.gloss: the contest of wild beasts or of wild beasts with men (ludus bestiarius).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18b">Ab. Zar. 18ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 1:1">Ps. I, 1</cite>) <he>זה שלא עמד בקיניג׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בקנגיון</he>) that is he who does not stand as a spectator at bestial contests (arranged by the Romans).
<cite ref="Psalms 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>לא עמדתי בק׳</he> I do not attend the shows of &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 613:1">Yalk. Ps. 613</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: the actors in the fights of the arena.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5">Cant. R. to II, 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00852"><he>בלטוורא</he></cite>.—V. <cite ref="S01578"><he>קְנִיגִין</he></cite>.
